title: The Last Broadcast
shortDescription: A 1936 island murder. An unbroken voice. An alibi made of sound.
description: Saint Bride Island, 1936. A gale has isolated the radio station, and its owner is killed during a supposedly live appeal. Four survivors have secrets, but the most convincing alibi may belong to a machine. Explore thirteen rooms, operate period recording apparatus, test witness accounts, and reconstruct a murder from physical evidence before making your accusation. Wrong accusations remain recoverable; an optional casebook supplies help.
author: Studio Null
